terms.title: Sharuɗɗa da Sharuɗɗa
terms.welcome_paragraph: Maraba da Myweddingpage ("mu", "namu", ko "mu"). Ta hanyar samun dama ko amfani da ayyukanmu, kuna amincewa da waɗannan Sharuɗɗa da Ka'idoji. Da fatan za a karanta su a hankali.
terms.use_of_service_body: Kuna amincewa da amfani da Myweddingpage ne kawai don dalilai na doka kuma bisa ga waɗannan Sharuɗɗan. Dole ne ku bayar da bayanai masu gaskiya lokacin rajista ko amfani da manhajar.
terms.payment_policy: 2. Manufofin Biyan Kuɗi da Mayar da Kuɗi
terms.payment_policy_item1: Dukkan biyan kuɗi na tsare-tsaren biyan kuɗi ko ayyuka ana buƙatar a biya su a gaba.
terms.payment_policy_item2_emph: Ba za a mayar da kuɗi ba bayan awanni 24 daga lokacin sayan.
terms.payment_policy_item3: Idan kun fuskanci matsaloli a cikin awanni 24 na farko, da fatan za a tuntuɓi tallafinmu don taimako da yiwuwar la'akari da mayar da kuɗi.
terms.intellectual_property_body: Dukkan abun ciki, alamun kasuwanci, da haƙƙin mallaka da suka shafi Myweddingpage mallakar mu ne ko na masu lasisinmu. Ba za ku iya amfani, kwafi, ko raba wani abun ciki ba tare da izini ba.
terms.privacy_body: Amfanin ku da Myweddingpage yana ƙarƙashin Manufarmu ta Sirri, wacce ke bayanin yadda muke tattarawa, amfani, da kiyaye bayananku.
terms.governing_law_title: 5. Dokar da za ta yi aiki
terms.governing_law_body: Wadannan Sharuɗɗan za su kasance ƙarƙashin dokokin Tarayyar Najeriya. Duk wata gardama da ta taso daga waɗannan Sharuɗɗan za a warware ta a kotunan Najeriya.
terms.international_users_title: 6. Masu Amfani na Ƙasa da Ƙasa
terms.international_users_body: Idan kuna amfani da Myweddingpage daga wajen Najeriya, kuna amincewa ku bi duk dokokin da suka dace a ƙasarku, ciki har da kare bayanai da hakkokin mabukaci.
terms.dispute_resolution_intro: Don rage shari'o'i da samar da hanyar da ta dace don warware rikice-rikice:
terms.dispute_resolution_item1: Idan rikici ya taso, za mu fara ƙoƙarin warware shi cikin lumana ta hanyar tattaunawa ko sulhu.
terms.dispute_resolution_item2: Idan sulhu ya gaza ko ba zai yiwu ba cikin kwanaki 30, za a warware rikicin ta hanyar sasanci mai ɗaurewa bisa ƙa'idodin wata ƙungiya mai suna (misali ICC, UNCITRAL) ko wata da aka yarda da ita.
terms.dispute_resolution_item3: Wurin sasanci zai kasance Lagos, Najeriya, amma za a iya halarta daga nesa.
terms.dispute_resolution_item4: Sakamakon sasanci zai zama ƙarshe kuma mai ɗaurewa ga dukkan ɓangarori.
terms.dispute_resolution_item5: Wannan sharaɗin ba ya hana kowace ɓangare neman taimakon kotu idan akwai bukata.
terms.limitation_title: 8. Iyakance Haƙƙin Da Za Mu Dauka
terms.limitation_body: A cikin iyakar da doka ta ba da izini, ba za mu ɗauki alhakin duk wata asara ko lahani kai tsaye ko na gefe da ta taso daga amfani da Myweddingpage ba.
terms.changes_body: Muna riƙe haƙƙin sabunta ko canza waɗannan Sharuɗɗan a kowane lokaci. Sabbin Sharuɗɗan za su bayyana a kan manhaja ko gidan yanar gizo, kuma ci gaba da amfani yana nufin kun yarda.
terms.contact_paragraph: Don tambayoyi ko tallafi game da waɗannan Sharuɗɗan, da fatan za a tuntuɓe mu a:
terms.contact_address_value: 147 NTA Road Mgbuoba, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria.

features.title: Duk Abin Da Kuke Bukata
features.subtitle: Kayan aiki masu ƙarfi da aka tsara don ma'aurata na zamani waɗanda suke son kyau da sauƙi.
features.gallery_description: Tsarin hotuna na AI tare da ajiya mara iyaka da rabawa nan take
features.gift_description: Bin kyaututtuka mai sauƙi tare da rubutun godiya ta atomatik da bincike
features.engagement_description: Littafin baƙi mai hulɗa tare da sarrafa lokaci na gaske da binciken ji
features.dashboard_description: Cibiyar sarrafawa mai hankali tare da basira da kayan aikin haɗin gwiwa

packages.title: Zaɓi Package ɗin ku
packages.description: Tsarin farashi mai sassauƙa da aka ƙera don girma tare da bukatun ku, daga ƙananan bukukuwa zuwa manyan bukukuwa.

find_wedding.title: Nemo Aure
find_wedding.description: Nemo bikin aure kuma raba farin ciki na ma'aurata a duniya.
find_wedding.no_weddings: Har yanzu ba a sami shafukan aure ba. Ku zama na farko don ƙirƙirawa!

testimonials.title: Masu Aure Suna So
testimonials.description: Haɗu da dubban ma'aurata waɗanda suka ƙirƙiri cikakkiyar ƙwarewar aure ta musamman.

testimonials.name: Sarah & Michael
testimonials.text: Dandamalin ya zarce abin da muke tsammani. Ƙiran yana da kyau kuma baƙi sun fi son abubuwan mu'amala. Sarrafa komai ba shi da wahala.

testimonials.name: Emily & David
testimonials.text: Kyakkyawan kulawa ga cikakkun bayanai da ƙwarewar mai amfani. Dashboard ya sauƙaƙa tsarawa sosai, kuma sakamakon ƙarshe ya kasance kyakkyawa sosai.

testimonials.name: Jessica & Ryan
testimonials.text: Na zamani, kyakkyawa da aiki. Iyalanmu sun iya kewayawa komai cikin sauƙi, kuma mun karɓi yawan yabo akan shafin aure namu.

questions.question: Shin dandamalin kyauta ne don amfani?
questions.answer: I! Muna ba da tsarin kyauta tare da abubuwa da yawa don farawa.

questions.question: Shin zan iya haɓaka asusuna daga baya?
questions.answer: Hakika! Kuna iya haɓakawa koyaushe don buɗe ƙarin fasali.

questions.question: Shin bayananina suna da tsaro?
questions.answer: Muna ɗaukar tsaro da mahimmanci, ta amfani da ɓoyewa da amintattun sabar.
